usedFor: Shopify holds orders, and buttondown updates a subscriber through “Update a Subscriber” after an “Order Cancelled”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Update a Subscriber” in buttondown
bestTemplate.why: Shopify pushes the cancellation, so the newsletter record changes as it happens.

watchOut: “Update a Subscriber” changes an existing subscriber, so the shopper must already be on the list.
